title: How we measure reach and time saved
body: Made cumulative reach more prominent, included Diagrams exports in estimated time savings and added a measurement breakdown. P2 Shapes now reports 200+ completed games from deduplicated game records and validated completion reports.

title: Teaching and learning North Star
body: Set the teaching and learning North Star to 1,800+ educators applying String products or concepts in teaching.

title: Product credits and past products
body: Renamed the collapsed historical group to Past products. Credited Jiaen for Seating, Sengkwang as Bingo’s inspiration, and Tiannuo, Evan and Matthew for Pathways.

title: Full String footer
body: Adopted the shared ecosystem footer on Reports and Changelog.

title: Teaching impact and estimated time savings
body: Made classroom application the North Star. Added 2,042 estimated educator hours saved, using two minutes per generated remark. Actual use of generated remarks is unknown.

title: A simpler front page
body: Aligned the columns, applied String Sky, shortened product descriptions and grouped products, programs and partnerships. Moved dated updates to a separate changelog.

title: Broader product and event coverage
body: Added P2 Shapes with tracked completions, and Seating, Bingo and Pathways with WIP metrics. Added the December 2022 NYGH / Praxium meetup; reviewed event participation is now 793+ across 19 sessions.

title: CherGPT usage and concise copy
body: Kept CherGPT at the approved 1,000+ all-time users and added 20+ forks as a separate usage metric. Shortened report descriptions.

title: Cumulative reach and Diagrams reporting
body: Combined approved product reach and event participation in the historical cumulative figure. Reported Diagrams exporter browsers and PNG exports separately from historical reach.

title: Historical participation and private source records
body: Added organiser-reported school and community participation, including historical Google and Meta meetups. Kept detailed event counts and source splits in a local CSV; public reporting uses period aggregates.

title: Community event review
body: Reviewed the String event calendar and excluded internal or operational sessions from impact reporting.

title: Shared UI and reporting foundation
body: Added shared UI components, reporting definitions and a guarded local reporting pipeline through the Spec Kit workstream.

title: Daily local refresh
body: Daily refresh at 06:00 on the Mac mini, with credentials and private data kept locally. Validated aggregate updates can publish automatically; anomalies wait for review. Source activation and scheduling remain pending.
